parameters.name: Domains
parameters.description:
An array that consists of the domain names of websites.

> A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) operation to query all domain names.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-web-precise-access-rule --resource-group-id default --domains www.test0000.com --owner manual --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo DescribeWebPreciseAccessRule --region cn-hangzhou --Owner manual --ResourceGroupId default --Domains.1 'www.test0000.com'
